OPRA (Open Parametric headphone EQ data), https://github.com/opra-project/OPRA

BM Player reads OPRA's database (database_v1.jsonl, from the mirror Roon Labs
keeps at opra.roonlabs.net) for its headphone correction, and shows each EQ
with the name of the person or project that made it, then OPRA's logo and a
link to the repository, as OPRA asks.

OPRA's manufacturer, product and EQ data is licensed under Creative Commons
Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0):
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/legalcode.en

OPRA's code is MIT licensed. Its database includes EQ data from the AutoEQ
project (https://github.com/jaakkopasanen/AutoEq), MIT licensed,
Copyright (c) 2018-2022 Jaakko Pasanen.

opra-logo.png is OPRA's logo (images/opra_logo.png in its repository), made
smaller, included for the attribution OPRA asks for.
